page: Microsoft Azure DC16ads_v6 is a general-purpose virtual machine belonging to the DCadsv6 server family. It features 16 dedicated vCPUs powered by an AMD processor with an x86_64 architecture. The server is configured with 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. Virtualization is managed via the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor.

This server type includes 614 GB of local storage and is designated as Premium Storage capable, allowing integration with high-performance storage options. It does not include any integrated GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given its balanced resource allocation of 16 vCPUs to 64.0 GB of RAM, the DC16ads_v6 is suited for general-purpose workloads, database hosting, and applications requiring local disk storage. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing capabilities, making it a reliable option for enterprise applications and web serving without the overhead of shared-core resource contention.
